characters.summary: Samwise Gamgee is a loyal and resilient hobbit who fights with a standard elven dagger (Sting) or a simple garden blade. While not a warrior by trade, his exceptional mental fortitude and deep devotion allow him to endure extreme hardships and protect Frodo.

mechanisms: High willpower and resistance to corruption

weaknesses: Normal physical vulnerability of a hobbit
limitations: Lacks superhuman physical strength or specialized martial training

sources.supports: General profile and role of Samwise Gamgee.

feats.claim: Stabbed Shelob in the belly with Sting.

notableResults.note: Ambushed and wounded the giant spider to protect Frodo.

unknowns: Exact limits of his resilience against supernatural despair compared to other Hobbits.

characters.summary: Saruman the White is a powerful Maia and leader of the Istari whose power lies in his mastery of voice, persuasion, and arcane lore. In conflict, he relies on spellcasting, telekinesis, and his staff to command elements and influence minds.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to physical betrayal when stripped of power
limitations: Power diminished significantly after his staff was broken by Gandalf

sources.supports: Abilities, role, and history of Saruman.

feats.claim: Summoned a blizzard on Caradhras using his staff.

notableResults.note: Defeated and imprisoned in his tower prior to his fall.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes powerful wizard staff and incantations.

unknowns: Full extent of his mechanical crafting abilities before focusing entirely on Isengard's industry.

characters.summary: Having rejected his original order, Saruman rebrands himself as Saruman of Many Colours, boasting an altered robe that shifts hues and reflecting his descent into pride and independent authority.
characters.formDifferences: Replaces his white robes with multicolored garments that shimmer and confound observers, symbolizing his break from the Valar.

sources.supports: Saruman of Many Colours transition in the text.

unknowns: Whether the multicolored robes grant any specific physical defense beyond psychological deterrence.

characters.summary: Sauron is a fallen Maia of immense power, functioning as a master sorcerer, commander of armies, and shapeshifter. He relies on overwhelming dark magic, intimidation, and telepathic dominance.

mechanisms: Nearly indestructible physical forms without specific weaknesses

weaknesses: Dependence on the One Ring to anchor his full power in physical form
mobility: Flight (as a shadow or spirit form)
limitations: Cannot easily manifest a physical form after the destruction of the Ring

sources.supports: Abilities, history, and status of Sauron.

feats.claim: Swept away multiple soldiers with a single swing of his mace during the Siege of Barad-dûr.

notableResults.note: Killed both leaders, though he was simultaneously mortally wounded/overthrown.

unknowns: The exact mechanics of how his spirit survived the sinking of Númenor.

characters.summary: In his fair guise as Annatar, Sauron operates through deception, manipulation, and supreme craftsmanship to trick the Elves of Eregion into forging the Rings of Power.

mechanisms: Diplomatic immunity granted by his fair appearance

weaknesses: Mistrust by specific perceptive entities like Gil-galad and Elrond
characters.formDifferences: Assumes a radiant, beautiful physical form capable of deceiving high elves, contrasting with his later armored dark lord appearance.

sources.supports: Annatar persona and deception of the Elves.

unknowns: Exact details of how he taught ring-lore to Celebrimbor.

characters.summary: Amplified by the One Ring, Sauron channels the entirety of his native power, granting him supreme dominion over wills, heightened physical prowess, and near-absolute control over Middle-earth's dark forces.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to having the Ring forcibly severed from his hand
characters.formDifferences: Wears the One Ring on his hand, concentrating his dispersed power and maximizing his combat effectiveness.

sources.supports: The One Ring connection to Sauron's power.

unknowns: Whether he could have defeated Valar intervention directly with the Ring.

characters.summary: Shagrat is a fierce and brutal Uruk-hai captain of the Mordor garrison at Cirith Ungol. He relies on brute strength, cruel weaponry, and aggressive close-quarters brawling.
weaknesses: Prone to violent infighting and greed
limitations: Lacks strategic discipline outside of direct orders from Mordor

sources.supports: Shagrat's role as captain of Cirith Ungol.

feats.claim: Fought and killed Gorbag during a dispute over Frodo's Mithril coat.

unknowns: His exact combat feats against skilled men or elves.

characters.summary: Shelob is an ancient, giant demonic spider residing in the pass of Cirith Ungol. She hunts by stealth, trapping victims in thick webs and subduing them with potent paralyzing venom before feeding.
weaknesses: Extreme aversion to bright light (such as the Phial of Galadriel)
limitations: Cannot easily withstand concentrated light or magical radiance

feats.claim: Paralyzed Frodo Baggins with a venomous sting in her tunnels.

notableResults.note: Driven off after being severely wounded by Sam with Sting.

campaignTags.claim: Monstrous giant spider of ancient lineage.

unknowns: The full extent of her lineage beyond being a descendant of Ungoliant.

characters.summary: Smaug the Golden is a colossal, fire-breathing dragon possessing immense physical strength, highly intelligent cunning, and an impenetrable armored hide encrusted with gems.

mechanisms: Impenetrable scale armor encrusted with precious stones

weaknesses: A single unprotected bare spot on his left breast where a scale is missing
limitations: Vulnerable if his single missing belly scale is targeted by a specialized projectile

feats.claim: Destroyed the town of Dale and burned Esgaroth (Lake-town) to the ground.

notableResults.note: Killed by a Black Arrow shot into his bare chest spot.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses massive dragon wings for flight.

unknowns: Whether his fire is magical in origin or purely biological.

characters.summary: Tar-Aldarion was the sixth King of Númenor, renowned primarily as a master mariner, ship-builder, and explorer rather than a frontline warrior. His strengths lie in leadership, navigation, and maritime logistics.
weaknesses: Normal mortal vulnerability despite Númenórean longevity
limitations: Lacks documented mystical or magical combat abilities

sources.supports: Biographical details of Tar-Aldarion as a mariner king.

feats.claim: Successfully navigated uncharted oceanic routes to Middle-earth repeatedly.

unknowns: Specific details of skirmishes he may have fought against local populations in Middle-earth during his explorations.
